object.attr: analysis: review Q16. A person can stage part of a file with `git add -p` while Mellon commits the whole working-copy file; an index that kept the partial stage would show a staged change that undoes part of the commit. The docs don't say what the index holds afterwards.
object.description: When Mellon commits, Mellon shall leave the git index entry of each committed file equal to the file in the new commit.
